falseSynonyms.zh: 動畫不等於 manga anime 是動畫媒介；manga 是漫畫／連環圖像作品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Anime is animation; manga is comics.

falseSynonyms.zh: 卡通不等於 manga cartoon 可指單格漫畫、卡通畫或動畫風格，範圍不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cartoon is broader and structurally different.

falseSynonyms.zh: 圖像小說不等於所有 manga 只有部分較長篇、完整成冊的 manga 適合稱 graphic novel。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Graphic novel is a format/category, not a synonym for all manga.

falseSynonyms.zh: 漫畫書是上位詞，不專指 manga 美國超級英雄漫畫、歐洲漫畫等也都是 comic books。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Comic book is broader than manga.

falseSynonyms.zh: 日式漫畫風不等於一定是 manga 非日本創作者也可採用 manga-like style。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Style resemblance does not determine origin/category.

falseSynonyms.zh: 插畫不等於 manga illustration 可以只是單幅圖；manga 依靠連續分格敘事。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Illustration need not be sequential.

falseSynonyms.zh: 韓國漫畫／華語漫畫不等於 manga manhwa 一般指韓國漫畫，manhua 一般指華語漫畫。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON These labels refer to different traditions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞義陷阱 manga 是作品／媒介；mangaka 是漫畫家。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Manga is the work/form; mangaka is the creator.
